nightsiege.guide.archer.body:
First your §esubclass§r: its skill is the first of your tree, you pick it with the class and get §elevel 1 for free§r. It also settles your §6way§r.

Trunk: §eAim§r (more arrow damage), then §eLight Foot§r or §eQuiver Keeper§r.

Then comes the §6way§r of your subclass. Every tier is a choice. Talents marked ↔ come from the other way, nodes marked ◎ are hunter skills (Mark, The Hunt) found in both ways. Shot and hit bonuses only work with the weapon of your way. Light Foot, Reload Rush, the Tripwire and the hearts and speed of the keystones always apply.

## Way of the Bow
- §eQuickshot§r (kit bow with Infinity, no Power; every click shoots, however short) or §eHeavy Shot§r (more Power, a short pause after every shot; plus the engineers' §eblast jump§r on the first key of the ability bar: leap back, push monsters away, +2 hearts); from level 2 on it needs Punch Through (for both)
- Talents: Double Shot, Volley, Impale, Heavy Arrow, Fire Arrows, Poison Tips, Eagle Eye, Fall Back
- Ultimate §eArrow Storm§r, §ePower Shot§r or §eThe Hunt§r, then a mastery for your ultimate and a keystone

## Way of the Crossbow
- §eBolter§r (shrapnel) or §eTrapper§r (nets); from level 2 on it needs Heavy Bolts (for both)
- Talents: Explosive Bolts, Multiload, Snare Net, Shackle Bolts, Punch Shot, Tripwire, Braced, Reload Rush
- A bolt triggers its talents only on the first monster, even when it flies through several
- Ultimate §eBolt Volley§r, §eNet Rain§r or §eThe Hunt§r, then a mastery for your ultimate and a keystone

nightsiege.guide.classes.body:
Every player picks one of four classes. The choice is permanent, but you can reset it §eonce§r at the core (button "Change class"): all your points come back. This is only possible until you earn your first unlock. You can look at the other classes any time.

## Profiles and unlocks
Every tree is a §eprofile§r, e.g. "Warrior – Berserker". Bring the §eult§r of a profile to §elevel 3§r and you get an §6unlock§r (once per profile). With it you pick a new class or a further subclass of one of your classes in the core window. The new profile starts at 0 and has its own tree and its own ult. A class has at most 4 profiles, each subclass only once.

## Points
Your points are one shared account. You can spend them in every one of your profiles, whichever you play. The start page of the core window lists all your profiles; a click opens the tree. At the horn a window asks which profile you defend the night with. Crate gains, kit and clothes count per class.

## Experience
- 1 point per 2 waves of a siege held
- Missed nights are made up in your next one
- Special nights (night fragment) count double
- The ult takes about 15 to 20 hours of play

## The tree
Every subclass has a tree of its own; the tabs at the top pick the one you look at (lock = not unlocked yet, ★ = the profile you play). At the bottom in the middle stands the skill of your §esubclass§r: you pick it with the class and get §elevel 1 for free§r. Everything else hangs from it: above it the trunk, then the way of your subclass (the other way stays shut), then tier by tier up to the keystone. From level 2 on the subclass skill needs the first node of its way, and the tiers above need it at level 2. On every tier you take one node; above the way every tier needs a node of the tier below. A choice closes at most nodes of the next tier, never anything further up. The lines show what a node builds on and light up in your subclass colour once you can learn it. Potions and salvos stand in a column of their own beside the tree. The mouse wheel scrolls through the tiers, drag to move the tree, ⤢ shows all of it. Point at a node to see its lines (green = met, red = missing, blue = leads on). A click shows everything about a node on the right, a double click learns it. Everyone sees your subclass next to your name. Red crosses show which nodes you shut by learning the node under the mouse.

## Class clothing
With a subclass you wear the clothes of the profile you play: every armour piece you put on shows the matching piece, whatever its material. Only the look changes, not the protection. Everyone else sees it too. An armour stand named after a subclass (e.g. "Berserker") wears its clothes as well.

## When skills work
- During a siege
- Always in creative

## For everyone
- /nightsiege eintragen | austragen - sign up for the nights, or sign out
- /nightsiege zusagen | absagen - answer the invitation
- /nightsiege info - state and level
- /nightsiege cores - known cores
- /nightsiege skills - your skills
- /nightsiege mobs - the monster list
- /nightsiege balance - evaluation of the nights so far
- /nightsiege base - check the base: closed, or where the wall is open
- /nightsiege playtest bereit | kisten | menue - in a playtest: ready, take the reward crates, open the menu

## Admins only (OP)
- /nightsiege start - start a siege now (no vote, everyone signed up nearby)
- /nightsiege stop - abort the siege
- /nightsiege test <level> [normal|blutmond|thema|finsternis|nebel|gewitter|netherriss|frost] - test siege, does not count

- /nightsiege test <level> vierer - test Night of Four: four bosses, two at a time
- /nightsiege test <level> doppel - test double boss night: two bosses after 15 s
- /nightsiege playtest <target level> [allein] - playtest (with “allein” only you): everyone signed up online plans class and skill path, then 4 nights up to the target level, before each a war camp or a dungeon; afterwards everything is as before
- /nightsiege playtest weiter | stop | status - next part, stop (everything back), state
- /nightsiege reload - reload the settings
- /nightsiege session start - new test session, the old protocol is put aside
- /nightsiege kit <level> - test kit and skill points for everyone nearby
- /nightsiege balance test - evaluation including test nights
- /nightsiege base radius <blocks> - search radius of the base scan
- /nightsiege ereignis polarlicht | polarlicht_ende - trigger a special event
- /nightsiege dungeon melden [kind] - the scouts report a dungeon now
- /nightsiege dungeon bauen | hin - build it at once, travel to its gate
- /nightsiege dungeon hier <kind> - build a dungeon here (to look at and test)
- /nightsiege dungeon status | weg - state of the fight, remove the dungeon
- /nightsiege dungeon perk <perk> <stage> - set a perk stage

## Creative only
- /nightsiege dev <points> - grant experience
- /nightsiege dev reset - reset your class

nightsiege.guide.core.body:
@nightsiege:siege_core|The core replaces the bed as the heart of your base.

- There is §eonly one core§r per world. The first player gets it for free
- Nothing in the world destroys it. Only admins can break it, and never between the horn and the end of the siege. Broken, everything stays saved
- Recipe: nether star in the middle, 4 diamond blocks on the sides, 4 obsidian in the corners
- Right click opens the core window with the situation, the classes, the collection and the night fragments

## Signing up
Taking part is a choice: right click the core and §a[Sign up]§r. You stay signed up until you sign out in the situation tab. Players who are not signed up see nothing of the mod: no invitation, no monsters, no bar.

## Invitation and vote
Every §e3 days§r the invitation comes in the morning. Accept or decline in the chat or in the situation tab. With §e3 accepts§r the night is played, otherwise it is skipped. The situation tab shows when the next invitation comes and who has accepted.

## Rebuilding
After every night everything the monsters destroyed comes back: the wall, the holes of the sapper creepers, explosion craters and what the diggers broke. Chests and other containers caught in an explosion do not come back; their contents lie on the ground. Nobody mends the blast of a lost night.

## Your base
The mod sees what you built around the core. If the base is closed all round, monsters spawn §e6 to 20 blocks outside the wall§r. If it is open, they spawn behind the buildings. Doors and gates always count as gaps. The situation tab shows whether the wall is closed or where it is open, and particles mark the spot.
- /nightsiege base - check the base
- /nightsiege base radius <blocks> - how far the mod looks around the core (admin, default 64)

nightsiege.guide.dungeons.body:
After every siege there is a 50 % chance the §escouts§r report a band of besiegers gathering in a dungeon the next morning – 250 to 600 blocks from the core. Only one is open at a time; it stays until you conquer it.

@minecraft:filled_map|In the core window the page §eScouting§r shows a map: the core, the target and the way between, plus monsters, champion and loot. §eTake the map§r gives you a map with a cross; held in your hand it shows distance and direction.

## The eight dungeons
- §7Stone Crypt§r and §6Desert Crypt§r: undead, champion Tomb Warden or Mummy Lord
- §8Illager Keep§r and §bFrost Keep§r: illagers, strays, standard bearers, iron knights
- §2Poison Swamp§r and §5Deep Dungeon§r: witches, bogged, spiders
- §cNether Forge§r and §7Basalt Forge§r: blazes, wither skeletons
The ground there decides which one comes.

## The way
@minecraft:campfire|You see the gatehouse by its column of smoke. Stairs lead down to the guard halls (30 × 30, with galleries, tower niches, pillars and half walls for cover). The halls lie offset, joined by corridors with a bend; every hall has its own theme. When a hall is clear, the gate to the next one opens. At the end a great stair leads down into the arena (45 across) with a ring gallery, tower platforms and the champion's pit.

## The fight
- A right click on the §eseal stone§r in the gatehouse starts the §eready round§r: everyone signed up within 20 blocks chooses a class. When all are ready, the gate goes up and you go down together: war horn, kit and abilities. The monsters attack at once, but they do not follow you up the stair. After 30 s the starter may go without the others; a second click calls it off
- Before the first hall a second gate waits: it only rises once everyone stands before it. Only then do the first hall's guards come
- Stray animals and monsters have no business down there: they vanish
- Down there you are locked in: whoever tries to get out (pearl, hook) lands back inside. The blocks cannot be broken
- Every champion has two skills of his own; he shows them a second before
- When everyone is in the arena, its gate closes: waves, then the §dchampion§r with a health bar
- Stronger with the world level: up to level 9 two rooms and two waves, up to 19 three, then four. Every further player brings 50 % more monsters
- Whoever falls (or disconnects) waits on the benches in the gatehouse – with their own things and the fight's bar – and cannot get back in. When the last one falls the attempt is lost – cleared rooms stay open

## Victory
- Every fighter gets a §eclass crate§r and §e5 skill points§r
- The group's §dnight fragment§r goes straight into the inventory
- Then the dungeon collapses: §e30 seconds§r, after that you stand before the gatehouse and the ground is as it was. Anything left lying about is put before the gatehouse

nightsiege.guide.engineer.body:
First your §esubclass§r: its skill is the first of your tree, you pick it with the class and get §elevel 1 for free§r. It also settles your §6way§r.

Trunk: §eSpike Trap§r and §eSnare Trap§r, plus §eBattery§r or §eFine Mechanics§r.

§6Remote control§r (every engineer gets one): X fires your second ult. A §eright click§r opens the §etower menu§r with all your traps and towers. Towers have endless shots, traps and towers never break. In the menu you click §eStrengthen§r on a tower and type a code of 5 arrows (WASD or arrow keys, like in Helldivers); 3 s later the tower deals 50 % more damage for 20 s (longer with Fine Mechanics), and in its last 5 s you can strengthen it again. The demolition expert can do it from the bird's-eye view too. §eAbility 2§r: on an own trap it overcharges (mortar, potion thrower and flame trap fire at once), on a monster it marks it, on a block it aims all mortars in range there. Without a spot or a target it costs nothing. Every order costs energy (the blue bar), which comes back by itself. Overcharging a tower (arrow turret, tesla coil, mortar, potion thrower) takes 90 % of the energy, a floor trap little. Talents marked ↔ give you a trap of the other way.

Every tower has a fixed cap; Fortress Builder and Overcapacity allow one more, Field Technician one fewer.

§6Manning towers§r: a right click on your arrow turret or tesla coil (not with the remote, a block or a gadget in hand) sits you down in it, sneaking climbs out. Alone both towers fight with 60 % damage. Manned they only fire while you hold the left mouse button, where you look, with 140 %: the arrow turret fires its two crossbows in turn (head hits ×2), the tesla coil sends a discharge at its own pace that jumps on. While you sit in it, the tower takes the hits for you: it has three times your health, and arrows and other shots deal 70 % less. Once its health is gone it throws you off and fights on alone; for 20 s nobody can climb in, then it is whole again. Strengthening makes it whole at once.

§6Every engineer§r: the kit holds a §eflash grenade§r (right click: monsters within 5 blocks are blinded for 4 s) that comes back after 7 s. The first key of the ability bar (§eR§r) sets off the §eblast jump§r: you are thrown back a little, away from where you look, monsters within 3.5 blocks fly away and crawl for 2 s, and you get 2 hearts back; then a 15 s pause. Only from the ground does it lift you, in the air it only pushes you on – nobody flies over walls with it.

§6Dungeons and war camps§r: there you set up your towers and traps a second time, apart from the ones at home (caps of their own, free traps in the kit). Take them down and set them up in the next room at any time; when your fight there ends, they go. Mortars fire there too, and the bird's-eye view opens above you.

§6Bosses and champions§r: your towers reach bosses, soul crystals, egg sacs and dungeon champions 50 % further and shoot at them first, a marked monster 25 % further. They waste no shot on the bone lich behind his soul shield, they take the crystals. You mark bosses and champions with Ability 2 from 50 % further away too.

§6Alchemist§r: of the seven potions you learn §ethree§r (nodes of their own at the outer edge of the alchemist's fan). Your potions share one key of the ability bar (after the blast jump: G): hold it and pick the potion with the mouse wheel, a tap throws it at once up to 10 blocks away; it leaves a cloud for 8 s. Then §eonly that potion§r waits 20 s, you can throw the others right after (1 s apart). §eAbility 2§r throws the last one picked. Healing, regeneration, strength and swiftness only touch players, poison, slowness and weakness only monsters. You also learn the §eacid flask§r (a key of its own): acid over 3 blocks that hits and makes every monster in it take 25 % more damage for 6 s, 12 s pause.

§6Demolition expert§r: the kit holds a spyglass. A right click opens the bird's-eye view over the base (up to 48 blocks around the core): WASD moves the view, the mouse wheel zooms, a click calls the picked fire onto the block under the mouse, 1–5 picks the fire, sneak or Esc brings you back. Your body stays behind, unguarded. Point fire (every mortar in reach fires there) has no pause; barrage, area fire, smoke salvo and fire salvo are learned in the tree (two of the four), each with a 10 s pause; every salvo shell is one of your mortars' shots, they reload afterwards.

## Way of Mechanics
- Subclass §eGunner§r (arrow turret) or §eElectrician§r (tesla coil); from level 2 on it needs Circuit (for both)
- Talents: Turret Tuning, Ammo Belt, Capacitor, Chain Bolt, Seeker, Overvolt, Charged Arrows, Guiding Beam, Network, Backup Power, Watchtower
- Ultimate §eOvercharge§r (arrow turrets and tesla coils fire faster) or §eThunderstorm§r, then a mastery and a keystone

## Way of Chemistry
- Subclass §eDemolition§r (mortar tower) or §eAlchemist§r (potion thrower); from level 2 on it needs Detonator (for both)
- Talents: Flame Trap, Shrapnel Shells, Toxic Brew, Acid Slime, Scatter Fire, Accelerant, Napalm, Plague Throw, Target Blast, Blast Power, Creeping Poison
- Ultimate §eBombardment§r or §eToxic Cloud§r, then a mastery and a keystone

@nightsiege:remote_control|Remote control: energy refills by itself

Every siege hands out free traps, already with the warning (the horn at sunset), so you can set them before the first wave. But only up to the cap.

nightsiege.guide.guardian.body:
First your §esubclass§r: its skill is the first of your tree, you pick it with the class and get §elevel 1 for free§r. It also settles your §6way§r.

Trunk: §eVitality§r (hearts), then §eChallenger§r (aggro) or §eToughness§r (armour, also without a shield).

Every guardian draws monsters that attack teammates. Raise the shield just before a hit for a §6perfect block§r: the attacker is stunned. Damage you take, healing and barriers on teammates earn points like kills. §6Shield action§r: left-click while blocking. §6Shield energy§r: in the night you block 6 s at a stretch at most; the bar on the shield drains while blocking and charges again when you lower it. When it is empty the shield is locked for a moment. Talents marked ↔ come from the other way. The hybrid (tier IV) builds on your pick of tier III.

## Way of the Shield (combat bonuses with a shield at hand)
- Subclass §eShieldbearer§r (riposte) or §eBulwark§r (bastion); from level 2 on it needs Shield Wall (for both)
- Talents: Iron Guard, Steadfast, Shield Throw, Shield Bash, Iron Hide, Anchor, Boomerang, Vengeance, Hedgehog, Counterstrike, Thorns, Last Stand, Revenge
- Steadfast and the ↔ talents (Field Dressing, Ward) work without a shield too
- Ultimate §eShield Charge§r or §eTaunt§r, then a mastery and a keystone

## Way of Blessing (healing and shielding)
- Subclass §eMedic§r (Healing Hand) or §eWarden§r (barriers); from level 2 on it needs Field Dressing (for both)
- Talents: Guardian Angel, Triage, Shield Dome, Cleanse, Life Bond, Wellspring, Miracle Worker, Lightbringer, Selfless, Overflow, Grace
- Prayer and Saint strengthen barriers too
- Ultimate §eMass Heal§r or §eHoly Sanctuary§r, then a mastery and a keystone

§6Healing by key§r: Healing Hand, Ward Shield and Protective Dome each have a key of the ability bar (R, G, Y …) and work at once on the teammate you look at, else on you; §eAbility 2§r casts the last one again. The §emedic§r also has §eSelf Heal§r on a key of its own: the Healing Hand on yourself, whoever you look at (same pause as the hand). No shield needed; shield + left click still works.

Medic and warden see each defender's life under their name in a siege night (“♥ 14/20”, green, yellow or red).

nightsiege.guide.infernite.body:
Infernite is the tier after netherite.

## Getting it
@nightsiege:infernite_ingot|Infernite ingots come only from the §ereward crates from level 20 on§r: every crate then has a small extra chance of one. No infernite ore grows in the world any more.
@nightsiege:infernite_scrap|Old ore from earlier worlds: smelted it gives infernite scrap; 4 scrap + 1 netherite ingot = 1 infernite ingot

## Smithing template
@nightsiege:infernite_upgrade_smithing_template|You get one when your ult reaches its top rank. Copy it: template + 7 diamonds + 1 infernite block = 2 templates.

At the smithing table: template + netherite item + infernite ingot. Bow, crossbow, shield and mace are upgraded straight from the normal version.

## Class items
Every path has one infernite item. While you hold or wear the item of your path, your skills and ult work §ealways§r, not only in sieges. Every other infernite item is simply strong gear.

## Trying it in creative
In creative every class item lends you its path, fully levelled. §eSneak + Ability 1§r switches between paths on items with several.

nightsiege.guide.intro.body:
Night Siege turns your base into a fortress that has to be defended.

At its centre stands the core. Whoever wants to take part signs up there. Every 3 days an invitation comes; if enough accept, waves of monsters attack at night - a little stronger every time.

## How to play
- Place the core, sign up and build your base around it
- Pick a class and earn experience by holding waves
- Buy skills, unlock your ult, survive the sieges

Open this handbook any time with §eH§r (rebindable under Controls), with the handbook item, or from the tab in the core window.

nightsiege.guide.siege.body:
§6Keys§r: §eAbility 1§r = Q (ult), §eAbility 2§r = F (orders, second ult), §eSecond ult§r = X; with the kit, the kit bar at the bottom shows Q, F and X as big slots and below them spells, heals, the warriors' storm step and one key each for arrows and potions (R, G, Y/Z, C), the key small in its slot. Arrows and potions: hold the key and turn the mouse wheel to change, a tap throws the potion or goes back to normal arrows. What each symbol is and does: chapter §eAbility bar§r. During the night these keys belong to Night Siege only: Q does not drop, F does not swap hands. Change them under Options → Controls → Night Siege.

Every §e3 days§r an invitation goes out in the morning to everyone signed up: §a[Accept]§r or §c[Decline]§r. With §e3 accepts§r a horn warns at sunset and the siege begins at night. Defenders are those who accepted and stand within 120 blocks of the core. Too few accepts: the night is skipped and the next invitation comes 3 days later.

§eExtra siege:§r From world level 20 on, anyone signed up can call a siege for tonight in the core window, at most once a day and not on a siege day. Everyone gets the same invitation, and again 3 accepts are needed by sunset. The extra night counts like any other, the 3-day rhythm stays.

## How it goes
- A new wave arrives every 38 seconds
- A night lasts 4 to 10 minutes, depending on the level
- Survive to the end and reach the §ekill goal§r to win the siege
- The kill goal is shown in the bar: about 60% of the night's monsters must fall. Traps and turrets count
- Survived but missed the goal: the night does not count and comes again at the same level (no blast, no skill loss)

## Wardens of the night
@minecraft:ominous_trial_key|In a normal night (no boss night) one of the eight §ddungeon wardens§r comes at the end with a chance of §e20 %§r, in the look of his dungeon. From then on he is the goal: the night is won when he falls and lost when he still stands at dawn. His fall brings crates as in a fragment night and §e2 ability points§r for everyone still standing.

## Experience
- Every §e2 waves held§r give 1.5 points to everyone still standing near the core
- Players who missed nights catch up: in their next night every wave counts as often as the nights missed plus one (at most 4 times)
- Whoever falls in the night does not die: they watch the rest of it as a §espectator§r (at most 80 blocks from the core) and stand at the core with full health afterwards

## Night kit
@nightsiege:reward_crate|At the horn (or in a test night's preparation) your inventory is put away safely and you get the §ekit of your class§r: armour by level (iron/diamond → diamond → netherite → reinforced netherite from level 20), the weapons of your way, food, arrows and traps. Kit things never break, cannot be stored anywhere (no chest, vase, item frame, armour stand or bundle) and vanish when thrown away. After the night your inventory comes back, with everything you picked up in the night; only the kit things go. Crates you win with the kit on come into your inventory afterwards.

## Reward crate
After a win every defender gets a crate for the class they played. A right click opens it (also by day): a band of gains spins and stops. The gain stays in that class's kit for good. Event and fragment nights give better odds, duplicates pay skill points. Everything collected shows on the "Collection" tab of the core window.

## Crate items
@minecraft:tripwire_hook|Some gains put items into the kit (throwing axes, spears, barricades, war banner …). Gains with an ability (grappling hook, horns, cloak, trowel …) sit on the §egain keys§r N and M, with "Third Hand" also J. If you have more, click them onto the keys in the collection. §eRight click§r uses them; the tooltip says what they do. Barricades, banners, ladders and light vanish after the night.
@minecraft:goat_horn|§eSecond ult§r (legendary, one per class): key §eX§r, 90 s pause. Battle trance, lure arrow, mirror shield or magnetic field.
@minecraft:bundle|§eQuiver§r (every archer): arrow kinds from the crate are shots in the quiver. Hold the arrow key of the ability bar and turn the mouse wheel to pick the kind for the next shots; a tap means normal arrows again. For the summoner the bar keys cast the spells (way of the dead) or call (way of the light).

## Level
The level rises with every win. Up to level 20 the nights get harder quickly, after that more slowly (a quarter as fast), without end. Skipped nights do not move the level. Alone, each wave brings 4 monsters plus 1 per level; every further player brings 60 % more. Monsters get tougher and stronger and new kinds join - from zombies to ravagers with riders and monsters from Friends & Foes and It Takes a Pillage, plus the special attackers below.

## Battle plan
Every wave comes from one side, from level 6 with a flank from a second one. The bar says where, and a war horn sounds from there. The mod knows your castle by its walls: doors and fence gates in them are the §egates§r, houses outside belong to the ground in front. Monsters only spawn where a way leads to the wall.
- §eMelee monsters§r gather 7–12 blocks in front of the wall and wait until a way in is open: a ladder, a crater, a hole from the trebuchet or an open gate. Then they storm it. After a long wait they also take a way in on another side
- §eArchers§r stand in a line in front of the wall and shoot at everyone they see
- Whoever goes out in front of the wall is attacked. Players far away are left alone
- Spiders climb anyway; in an open base they come straight for you
- Every wave brings at least one ladder carrier

## Over the wall
Monsters do not dig; they get in other ways:
@minecraft:ladder|§eLadder carriers§r lean ladders against the wall. Ladders, vines and scaffolding help the monsters up too, and spiders climb anyway.
@minecraft:tnt|§eSapper creepers§r blow craters into the wall. What they destroy stands again after the night. Bedrock, containers and the core are always safe.

## War camp
@minecraft:gray_banner|Sometimes (20 %) a §ewar camp§r stands on the day before a siege, 80–150 blocks from the base, about 40 blocks across. Only the smoke of its signal fires gives it away.
- Outer ring: a palisade with a walkway, four tents with two vindicators before each, two watchtowers at the back with crossbowmen (they stay up there and shoot far; a ladder leads up), cooking fires, barricades before the inner ring
- Inner ring: opens only when all tent guards have fallen. Inside, the §esiege workbench§r stands on a podium; until then it takes no hits
- Alone: 6 tent guards and 2 crossbowmen. Each further attacker brings 2 tent guards and one crossbowman more (at most 4) and 30 % more life for the workbench (300 alone)
- While the workbench stands, reinforcement comes from the tents every 60 s: 1 vindicator and one per fighter, until 8 guards are alive. Attacking quickly makes it easier
Before the gate lies a fenced §eforecourt§r with the §ewar drum§r. A right click on the drum calls everyone signed up with a class within 20 blocks to the §eready round§r: each one chooses a class in the class window. When all are ready you stand behind the gate and bars shut it: war horn, kit (your inventory goes into the kit store) and 10 s of grace. Whoever goes further than 20 blocks is out; after 30 s whoever beat the drum may go without the others, a second beat calls it off. During the fight nobody gets out (whoever tries stands inside again) and nobody gets in.
Destroy the §esiege workbench§r in the middle and no siege machines come tonight. Whoever falls at the camp or logs out waits by the fire in the forecourt until the fight is over. If all of you fall, the camp has won and moves off: the machines come for sure. Leave it standing and they come as well. Your inventory comes back as soon as the fight ends or you fall. The camp and its forecourt cannot be broken.

## Siege machines
@minecraft:ravager_spawn_egg|After a war camp the monsters set up machines 40–60 blocks before the wall shortly after the night begins: level 1–5 one, 6–10 two, 11–15 three, then one more every 5 levels. Two pillagers work each and three guard it. With both workers dead it stands still until new ones come.
§eWeapons and towers do nothing – machines are sabotaged:§r hold §eright-click for 4 s§r right at a machine. Letting go starts over, a hit interrupts it. So deal with the guards first.
- §eTrebuchet§r: boulders tear holes into the wall
- §eEnemy mortar§r: a high arc over the wall, a red circle shows where it lands
- §eBallista§r: shoots at players on walls and towers; cover helps
- §eFire sling§r: fire pots; water puts them out, fire resistance helps
- §ePlague sling§r: poison clouds; cleansing helps
- §eGrappling ballista§r: a rope of ladders on the wall; knock one rung off and the whole rope falls
What they destroy stands again after the night.

## Special attackers
@minecraft:coarse_dirt|§eRevenant§r (from level 2): When it falls, a grave mound stays. After 5 s it stands up again with half its life – once. A blow on the mound, fire or a summoner taking the corpse stops it.
@minecraft:lantern|§eTunneler§r (from level 3): Digs in before the wall and comes up near the core. Dust and knocking give the spot away 3 s before. Blocks stay whole.
@minecraft:gray_banner|§eStandard Bearer§r (from level 5): Monsters within 8 blocks of its banner are 20 % faster and hit 20 % harder. It keeps to the back.
@minecraft:tripwire_hook|§eGrappler§r (from level 5): Every 15 s it pulls a defender standing high off the wall – a line shows it 1 s before. A shield blocks the hook, a hit on the thrower stops it, the fall does no damage.
@minecraft:iron_chestplate|§eIron Knight§r (from level 8): Slow, but arrows and bolts nearly glance off. Melee hits fully.
@minecraft:gold_ingot|§eTreasure Raider§r (from level 3, about one night in five): Glowing gold, it flees for 45 s and is gone. Who catches it: a reward crate for every defender with a chance of 50 %, else experience.
@minecraft:husk_spawn_egg|§eCamel Troop§r (from level 5): A camel husk, a husk with a spear in front, a parched behind.

## Curse & revenge
@minecraft:wither_skeleton_skull|The core window has the §ecurse altar§r (tab "Curse & Revenge"). Every signed-up player can lay up to §e3 curse stones§r on the altar or take them off again; they count for the next real night, after it the altar is empty. During the night it is sealed.
- §eCurses§r: Tough Brood (+30 % life), Bloodthirst (+25 % damage), Overwhelming Odds (+25 % monsters), Haste (+15 % speed), Blight (-50 % healing), Champions (a champion every wave), Onslaught (-25 % time between waves), Blunt Traps (-35 % tower damage)
- §eReward§r for a win: every curse lifts the crate odds half a step (beyond fragment nights), +15 % chance of a second crate and +1 skill point for everyone still standing
- A test night tries the curses out but pays nothing
@minecraft:skeleton_skull|§eNemesis§r: a monster that kills a defender flees in a cloud of smoke. In a later night it comes back with the 2nd wave: with a name, a title, a bar of its own, more life and damage and a trait (tough, savage, swift, armoured, fireproof, class foe, blood drinker). It hunts its victim. If it kills again it rises in rank and flees once more. At most 3 lurk at once; after two nights without it, it comes for sure.
- Whoever slays it gets its §etrophy§r (a head or a plaque with its name, victims and level)
- The §ewanted posters§r in the core window show who lurks and who is slain

## Defeat
If every defender falls, the night is lost. There is §ano penalty§r: no blast, no skill loss. Only a night fragment used for that night is gone. The level stays: the night comes again until you hold it.

## After the night
Won or lost: whatever the night destroyed comes back §aon its own§r – blown up, dug out, burnt, trampled, also torches that fell off and signs with their text. The night's fire goes out. Chests and other containers do not break in a night at all. What you break or build yourselves stays as you made it.

nightsiege.guide.ult.body:
The last node of every path is an ult - a strong ability at the press of a key.

- Fire it with §eAbility 1§r (rebindable under Options → Controls → Night Siege)
- Cooldown: 25 / 20 / 15 seconds by rank
- A slot left of the off hand (Q) shows the ult, the key above it and the cooldown
- Greyed out means: not active right now (outside a siege)

nightsiege.guide.warrior.body:
First your §esubclass§r: its skill is the first of your tree, you pick it with the class and get §elevel 1 for free§r. It also settles your §6way§r.

Trunk: §eDrill§r (more melee damage), then §eEndurance§r or §eFootwork§r.

Then comes the §6way§r of your subclass. Every tier is a choice: one node per tier. Talents marked ↔ come from the other way and replace your own. The hybrid (tier IV) builds on your pick of tier III. Damage, swing speed, critical hits and parry only work with the weapon of your way; hearts, armour, walking speed, evasion, auras, war cry and divine shield work with any weapon.

A warrior's life steal: the axe fighter (6 %), the blademaster and the paladin (8 % each) heal a share of every hit's damage, 2.5 times that on world level 1 (falling until level 15), at least ½ heart per hit (at most every 0.5 s); the axe fighter's cleave heals at half the rate. The berserker heals from hits only when his life is low, but more.

§eStorm Step§r (every warrior, first key of the ability bar, R): 3 blocks the way you look, every 10 s.

## Way of the Blade (swords)
- Subclass §eBlademaster§r (combo: swords almost without cooldown, iron sword at most) or §eBerserker§r (bloodlust); from level 2 on it needs Boss Bane (for both)
- Talents: Keen Edge, Precision, Tough Blood, War Cry, Blade Rush, Blood Blade, Parry, Frenzy, Evasion, Blood Price
- Ultimate §eExecute§r or §eWhirlwind§r, then a mastery and a keystone

## Way of Might (axes, maces)
- Subclass §eAxe Fighter§r (heavy blow) or §ePaladin§r (consecration against the undead); from level 2 on it needs Shatter (for both)
- Talents: Cleave, Headhunter, Holy Endurance, Vow, Crusader, Headsman's Axe, Holy Strike, Momentum, Aura of Blessing, Earth Shock, Divine Shield
- Ultimate §eGround Slam§r or §eHoly Light§r, then a mastery and a keystone

nightsiege.skill.a_barrage.desc: The bolts of the bolt volley explode: {dmg|h} hearts of damage within {radius} blocks.
nightsiege.skill.a_bracing.desc: While sneaking, bolts deal {a|%} more damage.
nightsiege.skill.a_clusterbolt.desc: Every bolt explodes within {radius} blocks: {base|h} hearts of damage (with Explosive Bolts their damage), plus {bonus|h} hearts.
nightsiege.skill.a_deadeye.desc: Arrow base damage {mult|x}, but {health|h} hearts less.
nightsiege.skill.a_deathmark.desc: Your arrows deal +{a|%} damage to monsters that are already marked.
nightsiege.skill.a_deathtrap.desc: Monsters caught in the net rain take {a|%} more damage while they are stuck.
nightsiege.skill.a_eagle.desc: {a|%} chance of a critical hit (+{crit|%} damage).
nightsiege.skill.a_explosive.desc: Bolts explode: {a|h} hearts of damage within {radius} blocks. No block damage.
nightsiege.skill.a_fire.desc: Your arrows set monsters on fire. Burning monsters take +{bonus|%} damage from your arrows.
nightsiege.skill.a_firestorm.desc: The arrows of the arrow storm burn.
nightsiege.skill.a_firevolley.desc: Extra arrows burn and deal {mult|x} damage. Burning arrows set monsters within {radius} blocks of the target on fire for {burn|s} s.
nightsiege.skill.a_hunternet.desc: Your bolts deal +{a|%} damage to slowed or marked monsters.
nightsiege.skill.a_lightxbow.desc: With a crossbow in hand, +{pct|%} movement speed per level.
nightsiege.skill.a_longshot.desc: +{a|%} damage per level against targets more than {range} blocks away (up to +{m|%}).
nightsiege.skill.a_netbolt.desc: Bolts slow the target for {a} s per level (up to {m} s), monsters within {splash} blocks of it half as long. {hp|+h} hearts of life and always a night totem of your own.
nightsiege.skill.a_netrain.desc: Ult: Nets fall on every monster within {radius*} blocks. They are stuck for {dur*|s} s and take {dmg*|h} hearts of damage.
nightsiege.skill.a_pierce.desc: Arrows also hit {a} monster behind per level (up to {range} blocks), with {share|%} of the damage.
nightsiege.skill.a_poison.desc: Your arrows poison for {dur|s} s (the undead wither).
nightsiege.skill.a_punch.desc: Bolts hit {a} more monsters behind, with {share|%} of the damage.
nightsiege.skill.a_quiver.desc: {a|%} chance per level that an arrow is not used up (up to {m|%}). With Infinity a free extra arrow with {extra|%} damage flies instead.
nightsiege.skill.a_reloadrush.desc: After a kill you are much faster for {dur|s} s.
nightsiege.skill.a_retreat.desc: Every hit makes you faster for {dur|s} s.
nightsiege.skill.a_shackle.desc: Bolts hold the target in place for {dur|s} s.
nightsiege.skill.a_siegeengine.desc: Bolt base damage {mult|x}, but −{speed|%} movement speed.
nightsiege.skill.a_skirmisher.desc: +{speed|%} movement speed, but arrow base damage {mult|x}.
nightsiege.skill.a_snarefield.desc: Bolts throw a net: everything within {radius} blocks is slowed heavily for {dur|s} s.
nightsiege.skill.a_sniper.desc: The power shot deals {mult|x} damage and hits up to {count} monsters behind with {share|%} of the damage.
nightsiege.skill.a_steady.desc: Half-drawn shots are pulled {a|%} per level closer to full power. Fully drawn bow shots deal +{full|%} damage per level.
nightsiege.skill.a_steelbolts.desc: Monsters you hit take +{a|%} damage per level for {dur|s} s (up to +{m|%}). Counts on top of marks.
nightsiege.skill.a_tempest.desc: The arrow storm lasts {extra|s} s longer and fires {arrows} more arrows per shot.
nightsiege.skill.a_trapmaster.desc: The tripwire holds monsters in place and deals {a|h} hearts of damage.
nightsiege.skill.a_tripwire.desc: A monster closer than {radius} blocks trips and is slowed for {dur|s} s (every {cd|s} s).
nightsiege.skill.a_venomburst.desc: Hitting a poisoned monster poisons everything within {radius} blocks for {dur|s} s.
nightsiege.skill.a_volley.desc: Every {every}th shot fires {arrows} more arrows as a fan.
nightsiege.skill.a_watchful.desc: Every bolt marks its target for {dur|s} s with +{a|%} damage (on top of Mark). But {health|h} hearts less.
nightsiege.skill.a_widenet.desc: The bolts of the bolt volley slow heavily for {dur|s} s.
nightsiege.skill.archer_focus.desc: +{a} arrow base damage per level (up to +{m}), with bows and crossbows.
nightsiege.skill.arrow_storm.desc: Ult: For {dur*|s} s every shot fires {arrows} more arrows.
nightsiege.skill.arrow_turret.desc: Shoots the nearest monster, marked ones first. Damage {dmg*} (grows with the night), every {cd*|s} s (up to world level 14 it takes {slowlow|x} as long, from level {slowuntil} {slowhigh|x}), range {range*} blocks, at most {max*} placed. Endless arrows; strengthen it in the remote's tower menu. Overcharging costs {overcharge|%} of the energy. Alone it shoots with {unmanned|%} damage. Right click it: you sit down in it and fire yourself with the left mouse button where you look, with {manned|%} damage; head hits count {headshot|x}. In the seat you take {seatguard|%} less damage from arrows and other shots.
nightsiege.skill.b_cross_bastion.desc: −{a|%} damage for every monster within {radius} blocks attacking you (up to {count} monsters). No shield needed.
nightsiege.skill.b_cross_riposte.desc: Blocked hits throw back {a} damage, perfect blocks {perfect|x}. Like every shield it has shield energy (6 s of blocking at a stretch). No shield way needed.
nightsiege.skill.b_cross_shrapnel.desc: {a|%} of the damage also hits the monsters within {radius} blocks of the target.
nightsiege.skill.b_hunt.desc: Ult: Marks every monster within {radius*} blocks for {dur|s} s. They take {bonus*|%} more damage from everyone.
nightsiege.skill.b_mark.desc: Monsters you hit glow for {dur|s} s and take {a|%} more damage from everyone.
nightsiege.skill.b_pack.desc: Hunt radius {radius|x}. Monsters are slowed for {dur|s} s, teammates within {range} blocks are faster for {dur|s} s.
nightsiege.skill.battlements.desc: Defenders up on the wall deal {a|%} more ranged damage and take {a|%} less damage per level (up to {m|%}).
nightsiege.skill.mortar_tower.desc: Lobs explosive shells in a high arc, over walls too, onto a fixed spot. To set the spot, hold the remote, look at a block and press Ability 2; every own mortar in range then aims there (can be changed every {aimpause|s} s). Without a spot it does not fire. A direct hit takes {zombie|%} of the life of a zombie of the night. Every {cd*|s} s (on every level {slow|x} as long), range {range*} blocks, area {splash*} blocks, at most {max*} placed. Ability 2 on the mortar: a salvo of {salvo} shells. Overcharging costs {overcharge|%} of the energy. No block damage, spares players. Spyglass in the kit: a right click opens the bird's-eye view (up to {spotradius} blocks around the core), a click sets point fire there for every mortar in reach.
nightsiege.skill.bloodlust.desc: The less life you have, the more damage you deal: +{a|%} per level, up to +{m|%} close to death. Your melee hits heal you for {steal|%} of the damage. Bloodlust splinters: {splash|%} of every hit also hits the monsters within {radius} blocks of the target, up to {splashlow|%} more at 0 life.
nightsiege.skill.bolt_volley.desc: Ult: You fire {count*} bolts with {dmg*} base damage each.
nightsiege.skill.bombardment.desc: Ult: {blasts*} explosions strike the nearest monsters within {reach} blocks, {dmg*} damage each within {radius} blocks. No block damage.
nightsiege.skill.c_cross_tesla.desc: You can build tesla coils (tier {tier}). This gives no free coil per night.
nightsiege.skill.capacitor.desc: Tesla coils +{a} tiers: more damage and range, shorter pause. No extra targets, and the cap stays.
nightsiege.skill.champion_bane.desc: +{a|%} damage against bosses per level (at most +{m|%}).
nightsiege.skill.double_shot.desc: A second arrow with full damage flies with every shot.
nightsiege.skill.e_accelerant.desc: Fire and poison feed each other: flames and mortar shells deal {a|%} more damage to poisoned monsters. Your potions set monsters on fire for {burn|s} s, and your potion poison eats burning monsters {a|%} faster.
nightsiege.skill.e_acid.desc: Monsters hit by the potion thrower take {a|%} more damage while the poison lasts and are slowed {slow} level harder.
nightsiege.skill.e_acid_fog.desc: Monsters in the toxic cloud take {a|%} more damage.
nightsiege.skill.e_backup.desc: Below {below|%} energy the remote recharges faster ({speed|x}).
nightsiege.skill.e_ball_lightning.desc: The thunderstorm jumps to {jumps} more monsters and deals {dmg} more damage per hit.
nightsiege.skill.e_battery.desc: +{a} remote energy per level (base {base}, at most +{m}).
nightsiege.skill.e_beacon.desc: Tesla bolts jump to your marked monsters first.
nightsiege.skill.e_blastpower.desc: Ability 2 orders (salvo, big throw, remote detonation): {a|+%} area.
nightsiege.skill.e_chain_reaction.desc: Every mortar shell also bursts into {count} small ones ({dmg|%} damage and {radius|%} area each).
nightsiege.skill.e_chainbolt.desc: Tesla bolts jump to {a} more monsters, even past the usual target limit.
nightsiege.skill.e_charged.desc: Turret arrows jump on as lightning to one more monster within {jump} blocks, with {a|%} of their damage.
nightsiege.skill.e_circuit.desc: Overcharging with the remote lasts {a|s} s longer per level (base {base|s} s, at most +{m|s} s).
nightsiege.skill.e_cross_heavy.desc: Sword hits deal +{a} damage and slow the target for {slow|s} s (Slowness II).
nightsiege.skill.e_detonator.desc: Ability 2 orders (salvo, big throw, remote detonation) cost {save} energy less per level (otherwise {cost}) and hit {dmg|%} harder per level.
nightsiege.skill.e_durable.desc: Monsters need {a|%} longer per level to break your towers (at most {m|%}).
nightsiege.skill.e_fastcharge.desc: Energy comes back {a|%} faster per level (base {rate} per second, at most {m|+%}).
nightsiege.skill.e_fieldtech.desc: The remote costs {cost|%} less, but {slots} arrow turret and {slots} tesla coil below the cap (never below one).
nightsiege.skill.e_finemech.desc: Spike, snare and flame traps last {a|%} longer per level (at most {m|%}); your towers stay strengthened that much longer.
nightsiege.skill.e_firebombs.desc: The bombardment's impacts set monsters on fire for {burn|s} s and poison them just as long.
nightsiege.skill.e_fortress.desc: +{slots} arrow turret and +{slots} tesla coil above the cap, but the remote costs {cost|%} more.
nightsiege.skill.e_longrange.desc: The remote reaches {a} blocks further per level (base {base}, at most +{m}).
nightsiege.skill.e_napalm.desc: Flame traps burn longer ({burn|x}) and {radius} block further. Mortar shells set monsters on fire for {shellburn|s} s.
nightsiege.skill.e_network.desc: Overcharge spreads for free to your traps within {radius} blocks ({share|%} of the time).
nightsiege.skill.e_overvolt.desc: Overcharged traps and towers, the mortar and potion thrower too, deal {power|x} instead of {base|x} damage.
nightsiege.skill.e_piercer.desc: During the Overcharge ult, arrow turrets and tesla coils deal {a|%} more damage.
nightsiege.skill.e_plague.desc: The toxic cloud is {radius} blocks larger and spreads to monsters within {spread} blocks of the sick.
nightsiege.skill.e_plague_doctor.desc: Poison lasts longer ({poison|x}), and potion poison also deals more damage ({poison|x}). In return {blast|%} less blast and fire damage.
nightsiege.skill.e_plague_mine.desc: The potion thrower's big throw (Ability 2) also bursts for {a} damage.
nightsiege.skill.e_pyro.desc: {a|+%} fire and blast damage (traps, towers, ult), but your floor traps last {wear|%} shorter.
nightsiege.skill.e_seeker.desc: Marked monsters take {a|%} more damage, on top of the {base|%} of every mark. A mark lasts {time|s} s and costs {mark} energy.
nightsiege.skill.e_slowpoison.desc: The poison of your potions lasts {a|%} longer and so eats {a|%} more.
nightsiege.skill.e_stockpile.desc: +{a} free trap of each kind per night and level (at most +{m}), only for traps you already get for free, and only up to the cap.
nightsiege.skill.e_superconductor.desc: The thunderstorm refills the remote and makes your arrow turrets and tesla coils fire faster for {time|s} s.
nightsiege.skill.e_sustained.desc: The Overcharge ult lasts {time|s} s longer.
nightsiege.skill.e_targetblast.desc: Turret arrows on your marked monsters explode: {a} damage within {radius} blocks.
nightsiege.skill.e_watchtower.desc: Arrow turrets, tesla coils and potion throwers reach {a} blocks further, mortars aim {a} blocks further.
nightsiege.skill.execute.desc: Ult: Instantly kills the monster you are looking at (up to {reach} blocks) if it has at most {limit*|%} of its life. Works on bosses too. Cooldown {cd*|s} s.
nightsiege.skill.field_dressing.desc: Every {interval|s} s you heal players within {radius} blocks (you too) for {a|h} heart per level (at most {m|h}).
nightsiege.skill.flame_trap.desc: Sets every monster around on fire, but nothing in the world. Damage {dmg*} (grows with the night), burns {burn*|s} s, radius {radius*} blocks, pause {cd*|s} s, {uses*} triggers, at most {max*} placed. Can be set off with Ability 2.
nightsiege.skill.fortified.desc: {a} s more time between waves per level (up to {m} s).
nightsiege.skill.g_anchor.desc: Sneak and block: −{a|%} damage from all sides, no knockback, melee attackers bounce off.
nightsiege.skill.g_bastion.desc: −{a|%} damage per level for every monster within {radius} blocks attacking you (up to {count} monsters). As a bulwark, hedgehog, vengeance, shield charge and debris deal {group|%} damage.
nightsiege.skill.g_bladeshield.desc: Riposte, thorns and shield throw deal {mult|x} damage, but {hp|h} hearts less.
nightsiege.skill.g_boomerang.desc: The shield throw hits {targets} monsters, pulls them to you and turns their attack on you.
nightsiege.skill.g_challenger.desc: Monsters within {radius} blocks that attack teammates turn on you: surely with this talent, otherwise with a {chance|%} chance. +{a} blocks of reach per level. As a bulwark {bulwark|+} blocks and always sure. Shield fighters and bulwarks also take monsters off medics and wardens. Works only for shield fighters and bulwarks: healers do not draw monsters.
nightsiege.skill.g_cleanse.desc: On every ward pulse the weakest player loses poison, wither, slowness and weakness.
nightsiege.skill.g_counterstrike.desc: After a perfect block your next hit deals {a|+%} damage if it lands within {window|s} s.
nightsiege.skill.g_debris.desc: The shield charge leaves {hits} impacts of {dmg} damage each within {radius} blocks.
nightsiege.skill.g_dome.desc: Shield action, its key in the ability bar or Ability 2: a dome ({radius} blocks) for {time|s} s that pushes monsters out. Shots fall apart. {cd|s} s rest.
nightsiege.skill.g_eternal_watch.desc: The sanctuary lasts {time|s} s longer. At the end everyone inside gets {barrier|h} hearts of barrier.
nightsiege.skill.g_grace.desc: Whoever you heal gets {time|s} s of Speed I.
nightsiege.skill.g_healing_hand.desc: Right-click a teammate, the shield action, its key in the ability bar or Ability 2 (teammate in view up to {range} blocks): heals {base|h} heart + {a|h} heart per level. With no teammate in view you heal yourself at {self|%}. {cd|s} s rest.
nightsiege.skill.g_hedgehog.desc: While anchored your thorns hit every monster within {radius} blocks for {mult|x} damage. Without Thorns you sting for {dmg} damage.
nightsiege.skill.g_iron_will.desc: While taunting your bastion always counts {count} attackers, and you get twice the extra hearts.
nightsiege.skill.g_ironhide.desc: Every {interval|s} s: {a|h} heart of absorption for every monster within {radius} blocks (up to {count} monsters, at most {cap|h} hearts).
nightsiege.skill.g_ironward.desc: With a shield at hand: +{a} armour and +{toughness} armour toughness per level.
nightsiege.skill.g_laststand.desc: Below {below|%} health you get {time|s} s of Resistance II. At most every {cd|s} s.
nightsiege.skill.g_lifebond.desc: When your barrier breaks on a player, it heals them {a|h} hearts.
nightsiege.skill.g_lifespring.desc: Mass heal leaves a spring ({radius} blocks) for {time|s} s that heals {heal|h} heart per second.
nightsiege.skill.g_lightbringer.desc: Your heal aura reaches {a} blocks further.
nightsiege.skill.g_lightcircle.desc: In the sanctuary players heal {heal|h} heart per second, monsters burn {burn} s, the undead take {undead} damage per second.
nightsiege.skill.g_miracle.desc: The Healing Hand also gives a barrier of {a|h} hearts.
nightsiege.skill.g_overflow.desc: Healing beyond full health turns into absorption (up to {a|h} hearts).

nightsiege.guide.summoner.body:
First your §esubclass§r: its skill is the first of your tree, you pick it with the class and get §elevel 1 for free§r. It also settles your §6way§r.

Trunk: §eSoul Bond§r (more health for companions) and §eLife Bond§r (more hearts for you), then §eCall Range§r or §eCommander§r.

§6Summoning staff§r (in the kit): you fight along – about half the damage is yours, the other half your companions' and spells'.
- §eLeft click§r at a monster (hold to repeat): your attack. Way of the light: §eCall Strike§r, a hit spurs your companions on for a moment. Way of the dead: §eSoul Bolt§r, free
- §eRight click§r: way of the light – at a monster: all attack it; at a block: they hold there; into the air: call. Way of the dead – the last spell cast, once more
- §eAbility bar§r (the small slots of the kit bar): way of the light "Call", way of the dead every spell on its own key (R, G, Y/Z), with cooldown and soul cost
- §eAbility 2§r with the staff: order (attack or hold), §eX§r: second ult

§eCompanions§r share one mind: they stay close to you, first attack whatever attacks you or a teammate, and are back beside you at once when they get stuck or are too far away. Monsters go for them only from right next to them and only briefly. Companions never attack players, their kills count for the kill goal and give you points, and they vanish at the end of the night. They grow with the night like the monsters.

## Way of Light – Call of the Wild
- Pack Call for both (opens level 2 of the subclass): call wolves, every night starts with some. Heal wolves with raw beef and the golem with iron ingots (in the kit)
- Subclass §eBeast Tamer§r (up to four wolves) or §eGolemsmith§r (exactly one iron golem; on order it draws monsters to itself and slams the ground)
- Talents: Alpha Wolf, Pack Hunt, Snow Guard, Hardened Golem, Howl, Warden's Bond, Wildness, Care. With ↔: Bone Guard and Soul Harvest from the way of the dead
- Ult §eWild Hunt§r (spirit wolves) or §eTitan§r (giant golem), then mastery and keystone

## Way of the Dead – Soul Magic
- §eSouls§r: every monster that falls near you gives a soul. The bar of the staff shows them. Spells cost souls, the Soul Bolt does not
- Call of the Dead for both (opens level 2 of the subclass): Soul Bolt and gathering souls
- Subclass §eNecromancer§r (Raise Corpse, Bone Wall, Curse Zone) or §eSoulcatcher§r (Ghost Swarm on R, Fright on G). Raised corpses fight only briefly and burst at the end, two at most
- Talents improve bolt and spells: Skeleton Archers, Ghoul Hunger, Ghost Swarm, Ghost Haste, Rot, Corpse Blast (necromancer), Soul Shards, Ghost Host and Dread (soulcatcher), Unholy Might, Soul Pact. With ↔: Pack Call and Loyalty from the way of the wild
- Ult §eArmy of the Dead§r (a few of the fallen rise briefly) or §eSoul Storm§r, then mastery and keystone

nightsiege.skill.brew_heal.desc: Learns the healing potion for the ability bar: players in the cloud get {heal|h} heart back every second. Cloud {time|s} s, then a {pause|s} s pause for this potion only, the others stay ready. You learn three of the seven potions.
nightsiege.skill.brew_poison.desc: Learns the poison potion for the ability bar: poisons monsters in the cloud, the undead wither. Cloud {time|s} s, then a {pause|s} s pause for this potion only, the others stay ready. You learn three of the seven potions.
nightsiege.skill.brew_slow.desc: Learns the potion of slowness for the ability bar: monsters crawl through the cloud. Cloud {time|s} s, then a {pause|s} s pause for this potion only, the others stay ready. You learn three of the seven potions.
nightsiege.skill.brew_regen.desc: Learns the regeneration potion for the ability bar: players in the cloud regenerate. Cloud {time|s} s, then a {pause|s} s pause for this potion only, the others stay ready. You learn three of the seven potions.
nightsiege.skill.brew_weak.desc: Learns the weakness potion for the ability bar: monsters in the cloud hit softer. Cloud {time|s} s, then a {pause|s} s pause for this potion only, the others stay ready. You learn three of the seven potions.
nightsiege.skill.brew_strength.desc: Learns the strength potion for the ability bar: players in the cloud hit harder. Cloud {time|s} s, then a {pause|s} s pause for this potion only, the others stay ready. You learn three of the seven potions.
nightsiege.skill.brew_speed.desc: Learns the swiftness potion for the ability bar: players in the cloud run much faster. Cloud {time|s} s, then a {pause|s} s pause for this potion only, the others stay ready. You learn three of the seven potions.
nightsiege.skill.e_acid_flask.desc: Its own key on the ability bar: throws a flask of acid up to {range} blocks. It bursts over {radius} blocks: {zombie|%} of a night zombie's life as damage, a short slowness, and for {time|s} s the monsters take {acid|%} more damage from everything – good against bosses and champions. {pause|s} s pause. In exchange for learning only three of the seven potions.
